description: Run any quant tool by name with its arguments, e.g. {name: "sharpe_ratio", arguments: {returns: [0.01, -0.02, 0.015]}}.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments, as describe_tool gives them.

digits.description: Significant figures for fractional numbers in the result; default 10. Whole numbers are never changed. 4-6 cuts output tokens when full precision is not needed.

receipt.description: Add a calculation receipt (input and output SHA-256) so the result can be independently recomputed and compared; default false.

name: run_tool
title: Run a tool
